title: Surreal Indigo Mountain Adventure Landing Page

analysis.title: Surreal Indigo Mountain Adventure Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark indigo travel interface uses vivid orange-purple landscape artwork as its dominant visual language, with wildlife silhouettes and atmospheric depth creating an immersive hero. Repeated horizontal rules, numbered cards, compact metadata, and offset gallery panels give the long page a structured editorial rhythm.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a wide cinematic digital illustration for an adventure travel landing page: towering orange-red mountain peaks beneath dense lavender storm clouds, a reflective alpine lake, dark pine silhouettes, and two small bear silhouettes on rocky foreground terrain. Use bold flat-shaded forms, painterly texture, dramatic atmospheric perspective, deep indigo shadows, saturated coral highlights, and a centered composition with generous dark negative space for large white typography. No text, logos, or branding.
